name: hint-ladder
title: Hint Ladder
description: Reveal hints one at a time, from a question to a related example.
useCases: When stuck on a problem, a student opens a general hint first and requests the next one only if needed.
In a lab, an instructor arranges hints from a general idea to a concrete step. The app records how far each learner went.
task: Reveal hints one at a time, from a question to a related example.
behavior: Order hints from general to specific. onReveal receives the zero-based index of the newly revealed hint.
